Class ItemData

java.lang.Object
com.atomictempest.core.ItemData
public final class ItemData extends Object
Items that carry more than their id (API version 32): enchantments from Simple Enchantments, a creature in a jar, a name or anything another mod keeps in the item's metadata. Such an item is "special": plugins that sell, trade or mail items keep it whole (encode(ItemStack) and decode(String, String, int)) and never take it for a plain one of the same id.

    • problem

      public static String problem(com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.inventory.ItemStack stack)
      Why this exact item must not be copied into a shop, a prize or a reward, or null when it may (a plain item always may). Every buyer or winner gets a copy, so an item that holds other items (a backpack, a pouch) must be empty, one a mod knows by its own id cannot be copied (the copies would share it), and a very big one is refused.
